name: Sins of the Sacred
source:
Sins of the Sacred is a visual novel that tells about the influence of religion on a person. The main character will face death, sects, heaven, and hell. Maybe it will open your eyes, and you will see the REAL influence of religion?

[From [url=https://nayloft-games.itch.io/sots]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《神圣的罪孽》是一部讲述宗教对人的影响的视觉小说。主角将面对死亡、宗派、天堂和地狱。也许它会打开你的眼睛，你会看到宗教的真正影响？

[来自[url=https://nayloft-games.itch.io/sots]itch.io[/url]]
